remarks: Come and discover the charm of highly desirable Winnipauk Village in the West Rocks area. Imagine yourself living the carefree lifestyle here. Bring your own personal touches in addition to what is already in the unit such as, stainless steel appliances, classic crown molding, luxury vinyl waterproof flooring and living room with built-ins for additional storage. The washer and dryer ensure convenience for you. Relax and enjoy a cocktail with family and friends in the serenity of your back patio. This gorgeous complex provides a plethora of amenities to enhance your lifestyle. Immerse yourself in relaxation with access to 2 pristine in-ground pools, or engage in an active lifestyle with pickleball, racquetball, or tennis. Socialize and unwind at club house, stay fit by taking advantage of the gym. This village is enveloped by an abudance of lush greenery, creating a tranquil and picturesque environment that enhances the quality of life for its residents. Make this your new home and experience a perfect blend of comfort, convenience and community spirit. Take advantage and enjoy of all that the vibrant city of Norwalk has to offer, such as, the Oyster Festival, beautiful beach, SONO, great restaurants, the shopping mall. For commuters, Norwalk offers the trains into NY, easy access to I-95, Merritt Parkway and Route 7.
